name: block9-webhook-delivery
description: Web Nâng Cao, Block 9: giao sự kiện summary.completed qua webhook với transactional outbox, inbox và chữ ký HMAC.

scripts.logs: docker compose logs -f --tail 50 sender-api relay receiver-api receiver-worker
scripts.db:invariants: docker compose stop -t 0 relay receiver-worker && docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d app -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /app-tests/schema-invariants.sql && docker compose start relay receiver-worker
scripts.fixture:reset: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U app -d app -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -f /app-tests/reset-fixture.sql
